stages: 3. After accents, punctuation and legal suffix normalization

rules.rule: Vendor name has leading, trailing or double spaces
Raw vendor spellings that collapse after trim and case-fold
Raw vendor spellings that collapse after full normalization (punctuation, accents, legal suffix)
Normalized vendor appears under more than one raw spelling
Near-duplicate vendor (fuzzy token-sort similarity >= 92, numbers must match)
Same contract reported with different vendor spellings across its records
Canadian vendor with missing or NA postal code
Canadian vendor postal code not a valid FSA format (A9A)
Non-Canadian vendor country but Canadian-format postal code
Missing country of vendor
Vendor recorded with more than one country code
Competitive contract with missing number of bids
Contract value zero or negative
Original award record where contract value differs from original + amendment value
Contract end/delivery date before start date
Missing solicitation procedure
Compound or bilingual vendor name containing " / "
Vendor name exactly 35 characters long (likely cut off by a 35-character field limit)
Competitive contract reporting zero bids
Economic object code not found in the Government-wide Chart of Accounts 2025-26
Commodity code matches neither the published GSIN list nor the 8-digit UNSPSC format
